SELECT 'cron' AS o_que, jobname AS nome, schedule AS info FROM cron.job WHERE jobname LIKE 'compactar-%' OR jobname = 'cleanup-technical-logs'
UNION ALL SELECT 'funcao', 'prazo', CASE WHEN pg_get_functiondef('public.cleanup_technical_logs(integer)'::regprocedure) LIKE '%5 days%' THEN '5 dias' ELSE 'outro' END
